battle.name: 第一次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 巴勒斯坦中部沿海與耶路撒冷走廊
battle.brief: 1948年5月英軍結束托管巴勒斯坦，以色列宣布建國，阿拉伯聯盟自埃及、約旦與敘利亞方向進攻，第一場中東戰爭開打。這門一八五〇年的線膛野戰砲源出流入中東的施瓦茨羅澤七五毫米系列，到一九四八年仍留在埃及與約旦砲兵手上：前裝線膛砲已退居山砲位，決定戰局的已是退膛砲與空運。

countries: 第一次中東戰爭於1948年5月14日英軍停止托管巴勒斯坦的進駐後全面爆發，本質是以色列猶太國防軍與阿拉伯聯盟七國聯軍之間的一場大規模常規戰爭。以色列一方於5月26日成立國防軍，把哈加納、巴勒斯坦抵抗運動時期的地下民兵、海外支隊與英軍移交的裝備整編為一體：總參謀長雅科夫・多里掌軍務，本-古里安以總理身分主持作戰會議，海法、耶路撒冷、內蓋夫三個戰區分別由摩西・達揚、伊扎克・拉賓與伊加爾・艾隆指揮；另有約四五千名來自美國、歐洲與南美的海外志願者陸續抵達，編入帕爾馬赫各營及臨時突擊分隊。阿拉伯聯盟方面，埃及王國派出的軍隊規模最大，由穆罕默德・納吉布任總司令，約旦哈希姆王國由英籍陸軍元帥格拉布・巴夏訓練並率領的阿拉伯軍團擔任主力，敘利亞、伊拉克、黎巴嫩、沙特阿拉伯與也門則各自出兵；志願兵組成的阿拉伯解放軍由法烏茲・卡瓦基指揮，在巴勒斯坦境內配合聯軍作戰。聯盟各國缺乏統一指揮部，只在聯合國框架下由停戰監督組織協調，實際上各線互不支援，戰役節奏因此由各國將領自行決定。
countriesEn: The First Middle East War erupted in full once the British ended their Mandate over Palestine on 14 May 1948; in substance it was a large-scale conventional war between the Israel Defense Forces and the joint forces of the seven Arab League states. On the Israeli side the Defense Forces were founded on 26 May by folding the Haganah, the underground militias of the Palestine resistance years, the overseas detachments and the equipment handed over by the departing British into a single organization: Yaakov Dori served as chief of staff, David Ben-Gurion chaired the war cabinet in his capacity as prime minister, and the Haifa, Jerusalem and Negev fronts were commanded by Moshe Dayan, Yitzhak Rabin and Yigal Allon respectively; some four to five thousand volunteers from America, Europe and South America also arrived and were absorbed into the Palmach battalions and improvised assault detachments. On the Arab League side, the largest contingent came from the Kingdom of Egypt under commander-in-chief Muhammad Naguib; the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan fielded the Arab Legion, trained and led by the British general Glubb Pasha, as the main strike force, while Syria, Iraq, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia and Yemen each sent troops of their own; the Arab Liberation Army, composed of volunteers under Fawzi al-Qawuqji, operated inside Palestine in support of the coalition. The League states had no unified command: coordination existed only inside the United Nations framework through the truce supervision organisation, and in practice the fronts did not support one another, so the tempo of operations was set by each national commander.
people: 本場戰爭的關鍵人物集中在三端。以色列方面，剛於1948年5月就任總理的達維德・本-古里安是實際上的最高指揮者，由他決定攻守取捨，並在戰役命名上留下痕跡，例如1948年10至11月針對敘利亞的「德克姆行動」即以「東境」命名，象徵猶太民族對地緣極限的追求。國防軍初期的靈魂人物是摩西・達揚，他制訂了以閃擊與汽車化為核心的哈羅德計畫，主張在英軍撤走後迅速控制沿海平原與耶路撒冷走廊；摩德海・馬克萊夫與雅科夫・多里分任參謀與總參謀長，負責編制、徵兵與後勤；伊扎克・拉賓在耶路撒冷戰區頂住壓力，查姆・魏茨曼以總統身分爭取外援。阿拉伯方面，埃及的穆罕默德・納吉布是聯軍中唯一試圖建立多國協同的指揮官，但権限受限；格拉布・巴夏以英國陸軍的戰役經驗重整阿拉伯軍團，強調封鎖道路與控制橋頭；阿卜杜拉・塔爾以阿拉伯軍團參謀長身分主導拉特倫方向的攻防；法烏茲・卡瓦基率阿拉伯解放軍在北部游擊。最後是聯合國一線：貝納多特伯爵率停戰監督組織進駐，後由拉爾夫・邦奇主持談判，四份停戰協定的簽訂把軍事上的勝負轉成法律條文。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities of this war cluster on three sides. On the Israeli side, David Ben-Gurion, who had just become prime minister in May 1948, was the effective supreme commander: he settled every question of attack or defence, and his fingerprints remain in the naming of operations, as with Operation Kedem of October and November 1948 against the Syrians, which was named for the eastern horizon and expressed the Jewish people's reach for the limit of their geography. The driving mind of the early Defense Forces was Moshe Dayan, who framed the Harod Plan built on surprise and motorization and argued that the coastal plain and the Jerusalem corridor had to be seized as soon as the British withdrew; Mordechai Maklef and Yaakov Dori handled operations and the general staff, in charge of establishment, conscription and logistics; Yitzhak Rabin held the Jerusalem front under pressure while Chaim Weizmann, as president, worked the foreign lobby. On the Arab side Muhammad Naguib of Egypt was the only commander who tried to build a multi-state combined effort, though his authority was limited; Glubb Pasha rebuilt the Arab Legion along the campaign experience of the British Army, stressing road interdiction and control of bridgeheads; Abdullah al-Tall, the Legion's chief of staff, directed the fighting on the Latrun axis; Fawzi al-Qawuqji led the Arab Liberation Army in raiding operations in the north. Last came the United Nations line: Count Folke Bernadotte arrived with the truce supervision organisation and was later followed by Ralph Bunche as negotiator, and the four armistice agreements they brokered turned the military outcome into legal text.
kits: 卡面上這門1850年前後的歐洲前裝野戰砲，血緣來自克里米亞戰爭後成為各國標準野砲的施瓦茨羅澤七五毫米系列：奧地利原產的FK 15在1840至1850年代大量製造，經奧斯曼帝國與英國軍購流入中東，埃及與外約旦的砲兵在1948年仍保有其中的改裝型，用作後方支援、反裝甲直射與山砲位。到1948年，這條線膛血統在戰場上只剩次要角色：射界固定、裝填緩慢、無法夜戰，理論射程三至四千米卻被陣地地形限制；而真正決定攻守的是退膛砲——英製二十五磅砲、七十六毫米野砲與二英吋迫擊砲，美製一百零五毫米榴砲與五七毫米反戰車砲，雙方都靠它壓制對方縱深。步槍方面，以色列初期用捷克斯洛伐克製步槍與輕機槍，1948年6月起美製加蘭德步槍大批抵達；埃及與約旦以英制步槍、司太克式衝鋒槍與布侖機槍為主，敘利亞另有法製步槍。火箭筒方面，美援的巴祖卡與以色列自製的「大衛砲」——一款以進口無後座力砲改裝的臨時反裝甲武器——在內蓋夫與南部戰線發揮奇效。裝甲與航空更見差距：以軍初期只有半履帶車與吉普，第一支裝甲營到1949年1月才以斯圖亞特輕坦克編成，而埃及與伊拉克的英制坦克數量遠多於以軍；空軍方面，以色列航空隊從近乎零起步，埃及與約旦一方則由英國人操作的阿拉伯航空隊提供噴火式戰鬥機與教練機的掩護。
kitsEn: The muzzle-loading field gun on this card, a European weapon of about 1850, descends from the Schwarzlose 75 mm series that became the standard field gun of many armies after the Crimean War: the Austrian-designed FK 15 was mass-produced in the 1840s and 1850s and reached the Middle East through Ottoman and British purchasing, and modified survivors were still in Egyptian and Transjordanian batteries in 1948, used for general support, direct fire against armour and as mountain guns. By 1948 this line-gun lineage played only a secondary role on the battlefield: fixed arcs of fire, slow loading, no capability for night work, and a theoretical range of three to four kilometres curtailed by the terrain in which the guns were emplaced. What actually decided attack and defence was the breech-loading artillery: British 25-pounders, 76 mm field guns and 2-inch mortars, American 105 mm howitzers and 57 mm anti-tank guns, with both sides relying on them to dominate the enemy's depth. In small arms, Israel began with Czechoslovak rifles and light machine guns and received large deliveries of American M1 Garands from June 1948; Egypt and Jordan relied on British rifles, Sten submachine guns and Bren machine guns, while Syria also fielded French rifles. Rocket launchers made a difference too: American bazookas and the improvised Israeli Davidka, a temporary anti-tank weapon built around an imported recoilless gun, worked well on the Negev and southern fronts. Armor and aviation showed a wider gap still: the Israeli army started with half-tracks and jeeps, and its first armored battalion was formed only in January 1949 with M3 Stuart light tanks, while the British-built tanks held by Egypt and Iraq were far more numerous; in the air the Israeli Air Force started from almost nothing, whereas Egypt and Jordan were covered by an Arab air force operated by British personnel with Spitfire fighters and Harvard trainers.
tactics: 以軍的戰術圍繞速度與奇襲展開。計畫是在英軍全面撤退前先取耶路撒冷，撤退一旦落實，縱隊即沿通往雅法、海法與耶路撒冷的公路晝夜推進：以軍慣於夜間集結、白晝行軍，把輕裝吉普與半履帶車組成的機動縱隊插到敵縱深，再以步兵營配合迫擊砲與無後座力砲殲滅孤立據點；1948年11月在戈蘭公路一線的兩度空降突擊，就是用這種方式切斷大馬士革方向的公路與後方城鎮。城鎮戰方面，海法與雅法的攻堅以工兵爆破、逐屋推進與夜間突擊結合；耶路撒冷舊城由傘兵突襲奪取，之後拉特倫走廊的攻擊被阿拉伯軍團擋住——缺口寬度只有兩三公里，防守方只要把砲兵封鎖住這條狹窄通道，攻方車隊就必須改走更長的繞行路線，每次推進都要付出整個營的代價。阿拉伯聯軍則相反：正面進攻多、迂迴少，砲兵集中火力但缺乏射擊管制，裝甲與空中支援不足，糧秣依賴沿海港口與約旦河谷公路，供應線一旦被切斷，前線陣地在幾天之內就會耗盡存糧；埃及、敘利亞、伊拉克與約旦各自為政，6月9日的攻勢因各線不同步而未成合力。聯合國調解最終把戰局凍結成四條停戰線。
tacticsEn: Israeli tactics revolved around speed and surprise. The plan was to take Jerusalem before the British withdrew completely, and once the withdrawal became real, columns pushed day and night along the roads to Jaffa, Haifa and Jerusalem: the army liked to concentrate at night and march by day, driving motorized columns of light jeeps and half-tracks into the enemy's depth, then destroying isolated strongpoints with infantry battalions supported by mortars and recoilless guns; the two parachute assaults on the Golan road axis in November 1948 used exactly this method to cut the road out of Damascus and the towns behind it. In town fighting, the assaults on Haifa and Jaffa combined combat-engineer demolition, house-by-house advance and night attacks; the Old City of Jerusalem was seized in a parachute coup de main, and the later attempt on the Latrun corridor was stopped by the Arab Legion: the breach was only two or three kilometres wide, and all the defenders had to do was lock their artillery onto that narrow throat to force the attackers' vehicles onto longer detours, each push costing a full battalion. The Arab League forces were the mirror image: frontal assaults with few envelopments, massed artillery without proper fire control, little armor and no air support, and food and ammunition dependent on the coastal ports and the Jordan Valley road; once a supply line was cut, forward positions ran out of stores within days. Egypt, Syria, Iraq and Jordan fought their own separate wars, and the offensive of 9 June failed to achieve a combined effect because the fronts did not move together. UN mediation finally froze the battlefield into four truce lines.
data: 可核對的數字大致落在幾個區間。時間上，戰爭自1948年5月14日打起，到1949年3月23日敘利亞停戰、4月19日約旦停戰為止約十一個月，若計入1949年夏季仍在南部發生的零星戰鬥，還要再延續數月。兵力方面，以色列國防軍由5月的三萬五千人左右增至年底六萬至六萬五千人，其中海外志願者約四五千人；阿拉伯聯軍峰值約四萬人，埃及一國即佔兩萬上下，約旦阿拉伯軍團三千至四千人，敘利亞與伊拉克各數千人，阿拉伯解放軍數千人，黎巴嫩、沙特與也門的部隊規模有限。裝備流向也留下痕跡：以色列在1948年6月及其後分批收到美援步槍與機槍數萬件、迫擊砲數百門、火箭筒數百具，1948年11月的「尼克行動」以C-47空運方式運入半履帶車與一百零五毫米榴砲，總量約數百噸；埃及與約旦則由英國在二戰後交付二十五磅砲、戰車砲與噴火式戰機。損失方面，以色列陣亡約六千人，阿拉伯方面的估計從六千到一萬五千不等，各方數字分歧明顯，至今沒有共識。領土結果是：原巴勒斯坦托管地約二萬六千平方公里中，以軍控制約百分之七十八，約旦控制約旦河西岸，埃及控制加薩地帶，敘利亞控制戈蘭高地約一千二百平方公里。此外，戰後約七十萬巴勒斯坦阿拉伯人離開家園成為流離失所者，四十萬至五十萬猶太移民在1948至1950年間抵達以色列。
dataEn: The verifiable figures fall into a few rough ranges. On timing: the war ran from 14 May 1948 to the Syrian truce of 23 March 1949 and the Jordanian truce of 19 April 1949, about eleven months in all, and sporadic fighting in the south during the summer of 1949 extended it by several months more. On manpower: the Israel Defense Forces grew from roughly 35,000 men in May to between 60,000 and 65,000 by the end of the year, of whom some four to five thousand were overseas volunteers; Arab League strength peaked at about 40,000, with Egypt alone accounting for around 20,000, Jordan's Arab Legion at three to four thousand, Syria and Iraq at several thousand each, the Arab Liberation Army in the thousands, and smaller contingents from Lebanon, Saudi Arabia and Yemen. The flow of materiel left its own trace: Israel received tens of thousands of American rifles and machine guns, hundreds of mortars and several hundred rocket launchers in deliveries from June 1948 onward, and Operation Nick in November 1948 flew in half-tracks and 105 mm howitzers by C-47, several hundred tonnes in all; Egypt and Jordan instead received from Britain after the Second World War 25-pounders, tank guns and Spitfire aircraft. On losses: Israel lost about 6,000 men killed, while estimates for the Arab side run from 6,000 to 15,000, a spread so wide that no consensus has ever been reached. On territory: of the roughly 26,300 square kilometres of former Mandatory Palestine, the Israeli army held about 78 per cent, Jordan held the West Bank, Egypt held the Gaza Strip and Syria held roughly 1,200 square kilometres of the Golan Heights. In addition, about 700,000 Palestinian Arabs left their homes after the war as refugees, and between 400,000 and 500,000 Jewish immigrants reached Israel in 1948 to 1950.
cause: 打起來的根由有三層。最外層是國際安排：1947年11月29日聯合國大會以三十三票對十三票通過分治決議，議案把巴勒斯坦分為猶太國與阿拉伯國並附有國際化耶路撒冷等安排，這是聯合國成立以來第一次表決通過分割一個國家主權的決議，直接把國界畫到阿拉伯人居住最稠密的海岸地帶。第二層是二戰的餘震：歐洲猶太人口遭系統性屠殺，大批無家可歸者滯留在歐洲盟國，1947至1948年間大量搭船前往巴勒斯坦；同時英國在一九四七年實施分治前的委任統治、限制猶太移民，一九四八年一月宣布放棄對巴勒斯坦的委任並把英軍增至一萬四千人以上，令阿拉伯聯盟與猶太武裝都認定對方正準備動手。第三層是開火後的連鎖反應：1948年1月耶路撒冷被圍，哈加納對阿拉伯城鎮與交通線發動攻擊，1948年2月起英軍主力開始撤退，5月14日最後一批英軍高級職員離境，5月15日以色列宣布建國，阿拉伯聯盟部隊隨即由南、東、北三面進攻。建國與開火之間只差不足二十四小時，說明戰爭不是偶發爆發，而是被一年半的準備、國際決議與撤退時序共同推到臨界點的必然結果。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause behind the fighting. The outermost was the international settlement: on 29 November 1947 the United Nations General Assembly adopted the partition resolution by thirty-three votes to thirteen, dividing Palestine into a Jewish state and an Arab state while providing for an internationalized Jerusalem and other arrangements. It was the first resolution in the history of the United Nations to divide the sovereignty of a state, and it drew the border straight through the most densely populated Arab coastal districts. The second layer was the aftershock of the Second World War: the systematic murder of the European Jewish population left large numbers of displaced persons stranded in the Allied countries of Europe, and many sailed for Palestine in 1947 and 1948; at the same time Britain was still administering Palestine under the pre-partition Mandate and restricting Jewish immigration, and in January 1948 it announced that it would give up the Mandate while raising its garrison to more than 14,000 men, so that both the Arab League and the Jewish armed forces concluded that the other side was preparing to move. The third layer was the chain reaction after the first shots: Jerusalem was besieged in January 1948, the Haganah struck at Arab towns and lines of communication, the bulk of the British force began withdrawing from February 1948, the last British senior officials left on 14 May, Israel declared independence on 15 May, and Arab League troops attacked from the south, the east and the north. Less than twenty-four hours separated the declaration from the first shots, which shows that the war was not an accidental eruption but the inevitable result of eighteen months of preparation, an international resolution and the timing of a withdrawal.
impact: 後果是多層次疊加而成的。第一個是國家層面：以色列憑藉戰勝確立國家存續，隨後獲聯合國接納並得到英美等國相繼承認，海外猶太移民被大量安置，國防軍從臨時民兵過渡為以徵兵制為骨幹的常備軍，軍人成為新國家社會的核心群體。第二個是巴勒斯坦局勢：大批巴勒斯坦阿拉伯人成為流離失所者，1949年聯合國成立救濟工程處專責安置登記在冊者，這個問題此後數十年反覆牽動以色列與周邊國家，並在1967年戰後成為國際政治中最尖銳的議題之一。第三個是阿拉伯世界的政治心理：納賽爾在埃及的泛阿拉伯號召把這場失利講成整個阿拉伯民族的事件，軍隊與政權在不同國家間輪替，光是約旦與敘利亞在停戰後短時間內相繼更迭政權就反映反彈之大。第四個是冷戰格局與國際制度：美國在1948年11月首次以戰役級空運向海外派兵，英國照顧阿拉伯聯盟，蘇聯初期支持以色列而其後轉向支持阿拉伯國家，這條援助線的分岔此後數十年一直是中東的暗流；聯合國停戰監督組織與其後的觀察員團則開創了聯合國維持和平的新模式。第五個是結構性矛盾：以色列控制拿薩列湖與約旦河上游水源，約旦河西岸的用水歸約旦，此後關於水權的計算與爭奪一次又一次成為衝突的伏筆。
impactEn: The consequences were layered. The first operated at the level of the state: by winning the war Israel secured its own existence, was admitted to the United Nations and was recognized in turn by Britain, the United States and others; large numbers of Jewish immigrants were settled, and the Defense Forces moved from improvised militia into a standing army built on conscription, with the soldier at the centre of the new national society. The second was the situation in Palestine: large numbers of Palestinian Arabs became refugees, and in 1949 the United Nations set up the relief and works agency to look after registered refugees; the question would weigh on Israel and its neighbours for decades and, after the war of 1967, became one of the sharpest issues in international politics. The third was the political psychology of the Arab world: Nasser's pan-Arab call in Egypt turned the defeat into an affair of the whole Arab nation, armies and regimes changed places from country to country, and the mere succession of governments in Jordan and Syria within a short time after the truce showed how violent the reaction was. The fourth was the Cold War structure and international institutions: in November 1948 the United States for the first time sent forces overseas by operational airlift, Britain looked after the Arab League, and the Soviet Union, which supported Israel at the outset, later swung to the Arab states; the branching of that aid line would remain an undercurrent in the Middle East for decades, while the United Nations truce supervision organisation and the observer groups that followed opened a new model for United Nations peace-keeping. The fifth was a structural contradiction: Israel held the Sea of Galilee and the upper Jordan, Jordan kept the water of the West Bank, and from then on the calculation and the contest over water rights repeatedly became the buried fuse of later conflicts.
result: 戰事結束後，同年開始的四份停戰協定畫出最終線：埃及與以色列於1949年2月24日簽署停戰條款，界線劃在1月7日已生效的防線上，黎巴嫩停戰在1月23日，敘利亞在3月23日，約旦在4月19日，戰線因此從加薩走廊、黎巴嫩邊境、戈蘭高地到約旦河西岸逐一凍結，拉特倫走廊最後歸入以軍控制。1949年5月到7月南部仍有零星交火，是為「射擊季」的尾聲。政治上，以色列守住了建國，獲得國際承認，約旦收復約旦河西岸與耶路撒冷東城，埃及以軍管加薩地帶，敘利亞則把戈蘭高地握在手中直到1967年。軍事上，勝負的關鍵並非坦克對決，而是後勤、汽車化機動與空運的差距：一方能把砲兵、汽車與補給在幾十小時之內送到前線，另一方只能靠公路與畜力硬撐，攻勢一旦被拖入消耗戰就再無力氣。長期看，這四條停戰線構成了此後十八年中東的格局，1967年6月5日，以軍沿著同一批停戰線發動攻勢，幾小時之內就越過了1949年花一年才建立起來的防線。
resultEn: When the fighting stopped, four armistice agreements, negotiated from the same year, drew the final lines: Egypt and Israel signed on 24 February 1949, the frontier being fixed along the line already in force since 7 January; Lebanon followed on 23 January, Syria on 23 March and Jordan on 19 April, and the war was thus frozen front by front from the Gaza corridor through the Lebanese border and the Golan Heights to the West Bank, with the Latrun corridor ending up under Israeli control. Sporadic clashes continued in the south between May and July 1949 as the tail of what was called the shooting season. Politically, Israel held on to its independence and was internationally recognized; Jordan recovered the West Bank and East Jerusalem; Egypt kept the Gaza Strip under military administration; and Syria held the Golan Heights until 1967. Militarily, the outcome was not a duel of tank armies but a gap in logistics, motorized movement and airlift: one side could bring artillery, vehicles and supplies to the front within tens of hours, while the other could only grind along roads and on animal draught, and once an offensive was drawn into a war of attrition it had no strength left. In the long run these four truce lines shaped the Middle East for the next eighteen years, and on 5 June 1967 the Israeli army attacked along the very same lines, crossing in a matter of hours the defences that had taken all of 1949 to build.
